{{Top|leg}}
'''Attention to the Moment Gives Knowledge''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] exercise used to drill [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] on their environmental awareness. The Padawan closed their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and listed as much detail about their surroundings as they could remember.
